rules.explanation: Interrupt trabectedin until rhabdomyolysis fully recovers; urgent supportive management as clinically indicated. Missing recovery is not permission to restart.

action.message: Permanent-stop pathway: symptomatic cardiomyopathy, LV dysfunction not recovered to LLN within 3 weeks, or confirmed source cardiac discontinuation criterion. A previous permanent stop is not cancelled by a later normal LVEF. Complications/EMA include grade 3/4 cardiomyopathy and the specified LVEF decline criteria; cardiology must adjudicate their exact applicability.
